name: chatapp
description: ChatApp monorepo — Flutter client (app/) + Node/Express/Prisma backend (backend/)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && cd app && flutter pub get
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && cd app && flutter build web --release
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && cd app && flutter test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && cd app && flutter analyze
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && cd app && flutter analyze
